subject: Getting 429 Rate Limit Errors on /api/v2/webhooks endpoint
incomingBody:
Hi Support Team,

We are experiencing severe rate limiting issues on our integration. Our backend sends events to /api/v2/webhooks during high traffic hours (approx 5,000 requests/min). Starting yesterday around 2 PM UTC, we started receiving 429 Too Many Requests errors.

Could you check if our API rate limit was recently adjusted, or if we can request a quota bump for production?

Thanks,
Marcus Chen
Lead Platform Engineer @ FinTech Core
sentReply:
Hello Marcus,

Thank you for reaching out to engineering support.

Our system logs indicate your tier currently has a default threshold of 2,500 requests/minute on the /api/v2/webhooks endpoint. During peak hours, burst traffic over this limit triggers our automated rate limiter to maintain system stability.

We can increase your organization's rate limit tier to 10,000 requests/min for production environments. To process this bump, please confirm your Account ID (found under Settings > Developer Portal) and provide a target date for your high-volume deployment.

In the interim, we recommend implementing exponential backoff with jitter on your retry logic.

Best regards,
Alex Rivera
Senior Technical Support Engineer
intent: Request API rate limit quota increase for production webhooks

subject: SSL Certificate verification failed on custom domain app.acme.com
incomingBody:
Hello,

Our custom domain app.acme.com is currently throwing SSL handshake error ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID in Chrome. Users cannot log into our dashboard. We added the CNAME record dns.provider.com 48 hours ago as instructed.

Please fix this ASAP as our customers are affected.

Regards,
Sarah Jenkins
sentReply:
Hi Sarah,

Thank you for alerting us. I understand how critical domain availability is for your users.

I inspected your CAA and DNS records for app.acme.com. While the CNAME record is resolved, your DNS provider has an active CAA record that restricts Let's Encrypt from issuing certificates for your domain.

To resolve this immediately:
1. Log into your DNS provider (e.g. Cloudflare / Route53).
2. Add a CAA record permitting `letsencrypt.org` (issue "letsencrypt.org").
3. Once updated, navigate to Dashboard > Settings > Domains and click 'Re-issue SSL Certificate'.

Provisioning takes approximately 5–10 minutes after CAA entry verification.

Warm regards,
David Kim
Infrastructure Operations Team
intent: Troubleshoot SSL Certificate handshake error on custom domain

subject: Database connection pool timeouts during night ETL jobs
incomingBody:
Hi team,

Every night around 1 AM, our automated ETL batch job crashes with `ConnectionPoolTimeoutException: Timeout waiting for connection from pool`. We have configured maxConnections=50 in our DB config.

Is there a server-side idle timeout closing connections prematurely?

Best,
Vikram Patel
sentReply:
Hi Vikram,

Thanks for contacting backend support.

Yes, our managed database clusters automatically terminate idle connections after 600 seconds (10 minutes) of inactivity to prevent connection leaks. During long-running ETL processes, if connections sit idle between batch reads, they are closed server-side.

We recommend two options:
1. Enable keep-alive ping or `testOnBorrow=true` in your application connection pool configuration.
2. Increase `idleTimeout` setting in your pool driver to match your batch cycle timing.

Additionally, consider wrapping your batch reads in smaller transaction chunks to avoid long idle periods.

Best regards,
Elena Rostova
Database Infrastructure Support
intent: Resolve database connection pool timeout during scheduled ETL jobs

subject: Annual Home Office Ergonomic Stipend Reimbursement Policy
